report:
# PrimeSieve 413720 follow-up: final correctness

Final frozen header `final_frozen.hpp` is22168 bytes, SHA-256 `01344c288675f05141289cf151847c9ff52e80e6e587b852d9b2a92532aa7a30`. Tests run directly against this frozen file. It extends presieving through127, increments the enumeration word base by128, and fills the bitmap through reserve+pattern inserts. Removal of the unused old fill helper and its namespace closure are included in these exact-source builds. This validation task did not edit repository files.

All24 final configurations passed:

- Twelve C++23 builds: GCC15.2 and Clang21.1.8 × checked/skip × default-O2, SIMD-disabled-O2, and ASan+UBSan-O1.
- Eight supplemental native builds: GCC/Clang × checked/skip × SIMD enabled/disabled with-O2 -march=native.
- Four allocation-failure builds: GCC/Clang × checked/skip, each12 assertions and0 live allocations, without sanitizer allocation interception.

Every compile and runtime diagnostic stream is empty. Build CPU is10; functional execution CPU is2. Timings are test durations and do not establish performance. Matrix depfiles reference final_frozen.hpp, and readelf .comment preserves actual compiler versions. ASan runs with detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1; UBSan with halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1. LeakSanitizer was not run.

The byte-per-integer oracle is an elementary sieve through4,200,000, independent of odd-only bit layout, mask periods and blocked marking. It supplies complete expected prime vectors and primality bits. Across1151 boundary limits, each run checks full enumeration, count, prefix-preserving append and callbacks; performs5,859,040 individual primality queries; and checks ownership, wrappers and exceptions. New assertion totals are5,874,388 checked/SIMD or5,873,237 skip/SIMD. Disabling SIMD removes4896 direct helper comparisons, yielding5,869,492 checked or5,868,341 skip. The existing repository suite additionally passes675840/675360/674786/674306 assertions depending on checked/SIMD settings, including known counts at10M and100M.

The expanded mask coverage includes all values0..255, newly masked prime squares37..127 and first ordinary strike prime131, and representative phases after4096-word blocks1/3/7. For each prime, word counts around block*4096+prime±1 and each final word's bit endings are compared independently. Earlier blocked-build limit262144 and multi-block ends remain covered. Prime127, the top bit of word0, is checked both in small tables and after blocked construction; blocked limits262144 and4194304 compare every integer, including all restored presieve primes. Full prime-vector comparisons also validate every restored prime and excluded composite in word0.

The constructor's repeated insert coverage includes1155-word periods1/2/3/7/14/28, each±1word and±1bit, covering exact period completion, an empty remainder, one-word remainder and nearly full-period remainder. Bit masks in the final partial word are checked by full enumeration, primality around the upper bound and selected complete-domain scans. The append base increment is checked through complete ascending enumeration with nonempty destination prefixes.

Earlier tests are retained: prime-square/root boundaries,16384 enumeration path switch,255/256/257-word count switch,20 random limits, copy/move/self-assignment, moved-from reuse, callback exceptions, ownership independence and direct AVX2 CSA/wrapper comparisons. The historical MEDIUM_BOUNDARY output denotes general checks around the independently located131072nd/131073rd primes1742537/1742539; this final source has no special medium enumeration switch.

Direct AVX2 tests use zero/all-one/alternating/single-bit/density-step/random words, four unaligned offsets, counts0..32 at selected endpoints, and±4 around64/128/192/256/320/384/512/1024/4096/65536. Both wrapper and carry-save implementation match scalar std::popcount, including carry propagation across many64-word groups and all tails.

All eight default/native SIMD-disabled executable symbol tables have no CPU dispatch (__cpu_) or added AVX2/carry-save helper symbols. Standard fallback correctness is measured independently. GCC default exercises portable std::rotl striking; GCC native (BMI2) and Clang exercise existing4-unroll striking. Actual conditional macros are recorded separately.

Primary evidence:

- `extended.cpp`: enhanced oracle, SHA-256 `f8e2fd48c370ed4aad6174238a15fd8dcd7b956514586ad8db519a3d24d760a4`.
- `existing_simd_test.cpp`: copied existing test with an explicit return0 in its macro-renamed main, avoiding ordinary-function fallthrough; repository test unchanged.
- `allocation_test.cpp`: unchanged copied allocation test.
- `final/results.json`, `allocation.json`, `hashes.json`, `fallback-symbol-proof.json`, `conditional-macros.json`.
- `final_native/results.json`.
- Per-build dependency, compiler-comment, compile and run logs.

Preliminary baseline/three-candidate GCC checked/skip results remain in quick-results.json. They are not relabeled as the final24 configurations.

run_matrix.py.source:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess as sp,json,hashlib,os,time,sys
p=Path(__file__).parent
source=Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else p/'baseline.hpp'
tag=sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else 'baseline'
out=p/tag;out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
sha=lambda path:hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
(out/'hashes.json').write_text(json.dumps({str(f):sha(f) for f in [source,p/'extended.cpp',p/'existing_simd_test.cpp',p/'allocation_test.cpp',Path(__file__)]},indent=2)+'\n')
records=[]
for compiler,cc in [('gcc15_2',['/usr/bin/g++']),('clang21',['/usr/bin/clang++','--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15'])]:
 for check in ['checked','skip']:
  for mode in ['default','standard','asan_ubsan']:
   name=f'{compiler}_{check}_{mode}';binary=out/name
   flags=['-std=c++23','-Wall','-Wextra','-Wpedantic','-MMD','-MF',str(binary)+'.d',f'-DSIEVE_SOURCE="{source}"']
   flags+=['-O1','-g','-fsanitize=address,undefined','-fno-omit-frame-pointer'] if mode=='asan_ubsan' else ['-O2']
   if check=='skip':flags+=['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']
   if mode=='standard':flags+=['-DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD']
   cmd=['taskset','-c','10',*cc,*flags,str(p/'extended.cpp'),'-o',str(binary)]
   row=dict(name=name,compile_command=cmd,source_sha256=sha(source));start=time.perf_counter()
   q=sp.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);row.update(compile_exit=q.returncode,compile_stderr=q.stderr,compile_seconds=time.perf_counter()-start);Path(str(binary)+'.compile.log').write_text(q.stdout+q.stderr)
   if q.returncode==0:
    row['dep_verified']=str(source) in Path(str(binary)+'.d').read_text();row['binary_sha256']=sha(binary)
    Path(str(binary)+'.comment.txt').write_text(sp.check_output(['readelf','-p','.comment',str(binary)],text=True))
    env=os.environ.copy();env['ASAN_OPTIONS']='detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1';env['UBSAN_OPTIONS']='halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1'
    run=['taskset','-c','2',str(binary)];start=time.perf_counter();q=sp.run(run,capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=120)
    row.update(run_command=run,run_exit=q.returncode,stdout=q.stdout,stderr=q.stderr,run_seconds=time.perf_counter()-start,ASAN_OPTIONS=env['ASAN_OPTIONS'],UBSAN_OPTIONS=env['UBSAN_OPTIONS']);Path(str(binary)+'.run.log').write_text(q.stdout+q.stderr)
   records.append(row);(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n');print(name,row.get('compile_exit'),row.get('run_exit'),row.get('stdout','').strip(),flush=True)
   if row.get('run_exit')!=0:raise SystemExit('Matrix failure')
# Allocation-failure harness deliberately replaces global allocation functions; run independently, without ASan interceptors.
alloc=[]
for compiler,cc in [('gcc15_2',['/usr/bin/g++']),('clang21',['/usr/bin/clang++','--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15'])]:
 for check in ['checked','skip']:
  binary=out/f'alloc_{compiler}_{check}';cmd=['taskset','-c','10',*cc,'-std=c++23','-O2','-Wall','-Wextra','-Wpedantic',f'-DSIEVE_SOURCE="{source}"',*(['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']if check=='skip'else[]),str(p/'allocation_test.cpp'),'-o',str(binary)]
  q=sp.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);row=dict(compiler=compiler,check=check,compile_command=cmd,compile_exit=q.returncode,compile_stderr=q.stderr)
  if q.returncode==0:
   q=sp.run(['taskset','-c','2',str(binary)],capture_output=True,text=True);row.update(run_exit=q.returncode,stdout=q.stdout,stderr=q.stderr)
  alloc.append(row);(out/'allocation.json').write_text(json.dumps(alloc,indent=2)+'\n');print('allocation',compiler,check,row.get('run_exit'),row.get('stdout','').strip(),flush=True)
  if row.get('run_exit')!=0:raise SystemExit('Allocation failure')
print('DONE',tag,sha(source),flush=True)
